notes: Source ledger extension: docs/licenses/sources.json. Independent derivation from local bytes and official release metadata, archive members, asset README and build mapping, scoped source-map attribution, font name records and upstream license texts. Original Liberation archive retrieval was unavailable (ledger entry not relied on); four exact files are confirmed release blockers via Mozilla and the fonts themselves. Other unknowns are retained as findings rather than cleared. No third-party implementation copied, no changes to runtime, no verification of release packaging or application behavior. This record is not an independent review or release approval.

review.notes: Independent documentation approval. All 207 vendored paths match the exact official distributions. Four inherited GPL v2 plus exception fonts block release; remaining build, notice, ancestry and policy findings are not cleared. No license waiver, owner acceptance or release certification.
